advancement: User-authorized parallel confirmation: finish/report all fixed fresh families regardless of remaining BAA1 outcome; no adaptive seeds, draws, sample size or stopping.
chart_namespace: Inherited BAA1 SHA256(parent,draw,label); actual confirmation uses draw0 only, one fixed draw per fresh parent.
claims: Ancestry-specific correspondence prediction at fixed chart multiplicities and matched own-state geometry; not semantic neuron alignment or a new optimizer gain.
inference: Six fresh independent parent-plus-fixed-draw families; one primary reassigned-minus-preserved REPORT contrast. No pooling with BAA1/PCT1 or extra draws as independent parents.
primary: Reassigned-minus-preserved final REPORT loss over the six parent-plus-draw units, positive predicted; two-sided paired 95% Student-t interval.
release_default: Engineering only. --science is a separate explicit release after all gates.
report_policy: All 24 endpoints locked before any scientific REPORT; single prespecified paired 95% t interval; secondary contrasts descriptive.
seed_reservation: Candidate labels only until live registry collision checks pass; refuse, never auto-renumber.
unused_shadow_policy: Both original BAA1 chart draws and the original GCT shadow are retained symmetrically for reference continuity; draw1 is not an applied confirmation arm.
release_policy_revision: parallel_v1_2026-09-12; replaces unlaunched global positive-outcome admission only
prerequisite_policy: Unchanged BAA1 source/protocol and completed local lane required. No global efficacy outcome used. All physical GPU, runtime, cache and process admission checks retained.
design_history: Parent160 positive BAA1 evidence known before preparation. User requested parallel release before the whole development result; BAA1/PCT1 parents excluded from confirmation.
